note: Verbatim stdio transcript: OfferSheet MCP server spawned from a FRESH CLONE of remote main (not the working tree), keyless. Count is read from the tools/list response, not from any spec table.

tools.name: offersheet_verdict_run
tools.description: Runs the full OfferSheet verdict (Qloo evidence + Ticketmaster room + money + arms). Does NOT invent numbers: a withheld, price-unknown, or needs-input verdict is a success response with that status, never a number. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_verdict_race
tools.description: Same verdict as offersheet_verdict_run, plus arm timings (race: gutMs, webMs, totalMs). Does NOT change the verdict; it proves arm timing, which the plain verdict does not report. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_capabilities
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_capabilities tool (the pipeline readiness probe). Returns the upstream envelope plus an OfferSheet receipt. Does NOT invent a capability list when the harness is down — that errors. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_find_tags
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_find_tags tool. Tag URNs returned here feed the REST insights leg. Does NOT resolve an artist by itself. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_describe
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_describe tool. An ambiguous name returns needs_input with candidates — it is never resolved by guessing. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_recommend
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_recommend tool (opener candidates for a headliner signal). Does NOT rank the candidates — that is qloo_rank, or the sequenced offersheet_opener_shortlist. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_rank
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_rank tool. It ranks options a caller supplies; it does NOT generate candidates. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_where_popular
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_where_popular tool. Returns matched areas/entities only — Qloo returns no headcount, and this tool does NOT invent one. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_audience_demographics
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_audience_demographics tool. Bands carry no entity IDs, so their receipts honestly carry no ID list. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_entity_tags
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_entity_tags tool (shared tags for a set of entities). One of the two accepted overlap evidences, alongside qloo_compare_audiences. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_trends
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_trends tool (momentum over a date window). A failure is a labeled omission in a verdict, never a verdict blocker. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: qloo_compare_audiences
tools.description: Guarded proxy of Qloo's own qloo_compare_audiences tool (audience-overlap object for two groups). Distinct from qloo_entity_tags (shared-tag list) and from offersheet_rest_compare (REST transport). Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_rest_search
tools.description: REST name resolution via GET /search (key in the X-Api-Key header only, never in the URL). Accepts entities- or results-shaped bodies. Does NOT spend an MCP call. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_rest_insights_by_tags
tools.description: REST insights by tag URNs via GET /v2/insights with explainability on. Runs only when tag URNs are supplied; otherwise the caller reports it skipped. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_rest_compare
tools.description: REST headliner-vs-opener comparison via GET /v2/analysis/compare. An object body with non-error keys counts as a payload. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_rest_entities
tools.description: REST entity hydration via GET /entities. At most 15 IDs are sent per call (enforced, not advisory) — extra IDs are not sent. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_receipt_replay
tools.description: Re-runs a receipted call live (MCP allowlist or REST allowlist) and compares fresh ordered entity IDs against originalIds (match / mismatch / not_comparable). The Qloo key gate precedes validation: a keyless bogus replay returns NOT_CONFIGURED before any other check. Demographics/overlap receipts carry no IDs, so they honestly report not_comparable. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_receipt_verify_hash
tools.description: Recomputes a receipt's SHA-256 offline (MCP: tool + args; REST: method + url) and reports valid true/false plus the recomputed hash. Does NOT make a live call and does NOT prove the upstream data — only that the hash matches the claimed request. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_receipts_list
tools.description: Lists receipts from the session store (this process only; restart clears it) or reads the repo manifest (read-only; currently empty, returned verbatim with its note). The id / requestHash / operation parameters ARE the get operation — there is no separate get tool. This server never writes either source. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_trials_list
tools.description: Lists recorded benchmark trials from bench/results.json, labeled recorded, not live on every response. The index parameter IS the get operation. A missing file returns the honest no-runs note, never fabricated runs. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_trial_pack_verify
tools.description: Offline verification of frontend/trial-pack.json against bench/results.json: per-trial SHA-256 over the canonicalised core, packSha256 over the joined hashes, and every breakEvenTickets re-derived by ceiling division. Reports exactly which check failed. No Qloo call, no quota. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_arm_gut
tools.description: The Gut comparison arm: LLM alone, no external data. When no LLM provider is configured it returns status unavailable with no pick — never a rendered guess. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_arm_web
tools.description: The Web comparison arm: LLM plus Wikidata facts only. When webFacts is absent and artist is given, facts are fetched via the Wikidata path first; empty facts still produce an honest run labeled with no Wikidata facts available, never invented facts. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_miss_trial_build
tools.description: Builds a miss-ledger trial from picks, purely offline. Returns null (no trial) unless a graph pick AND at least one comparison pick are present; identical picks yield a trial with empty misses. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_venue_search
tools.description: Raw Ticketmaster venue lookup for a named room. A null result means the room did not resolve — never a guessed venue. This answers the lookup alone, without spending an events call. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_room_grounding
tools.description: The composed Ticketmaster room leg: resolve a named room first, then scope the event lookup to its venue ID. Returns events found, venue name, capacity (value or unknown with its cause), price (value + source), and the grounding label — a resolved room's capacity is never borrowed from another room's event, and a first-event price/capacity is never silently labeled as the offer room's. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_deal_breakeven
tools.description: Pure break-even arithmetic: tickets = ceil(guarantee / (ticketPrice - variableCost)); guarantee 0 gives 0 tickets with note no guarantee; net <= 0 is an error, never division by zero; tickets over a known capacity give Cannot break even in this room at this guarantee. A missing ticket price is an error, never an invented number. variableCostProvided keeps a blank cost distinct from zero cost. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_city_geocode
tools.description: Keyless Nominatim city lookup (display name + lat/lon, or unavailable). Scope label on every response: display-only — shown for confirmation, never fed into Qloo filters. A failure never yields a guessed coordinate. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_artist_facts
tools.description: Wikidata name-to-entity search only (id / label / description matches). Scope label on every response: input to the Web arm only, never a direct verdict input. No claim is ever derived from Wikidata alone. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_health
tools.description: Booleans only — qlooConfigured, ticketmasterConfigured, llmConfigured — plus status ok and version. No keys, no counts, no guard internals. Works with no keys configured; it is the tool that tells a client whether the others can work. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_limits_status
tools.description: The server process's single Guards snapshot: monthlyBudget, monthlyCount, perVisitorDailyCap, perRunCallCap. These are OfferSheet's own adopted tripwires, NOT Qloo-stated quotas. Restart clears guard counters and the session receipt store. There is NO per-visitor usage lookup — Guards has no read method for it — so none is invented here. Spends no Qloo calls.

tools.name: offersheet_opener_shortlist
tools.description: The composed opener chain: resolve the headliner, recommend opener candidates, then rank those candidates for the city audience — rank consumes recommend's output, so the steps stay sequential, never parallelised. Plus Gap-3 ID threading: an ID-less candidate gets one describe call before downstream use; a failed or ambiguous resolution keeps the name signal, never a guessed ID. Distinct from the plain verdict (no guarantee, no money, no full evidence legs, no venue/arms) and from calling recommend + rank by hand (the sequencing + ID threading is the logic). When recommend is empty, rank is honestly skipped, never an empty ranking presented as a pick. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).

tools.name: offersheet_opener_rerank
tools.description: The HTTP POST /api/verdict/rerank endpoint as a tool, reusing its logic 1:1 (buildRerankArgs + one qloo_rank call + formatRerankResult, same receipt claim). Re-runs ONLY the ranking step with the same candidate set minus the excluded pick; the original verdict is never touched. An ok-but-empty rank envelope returns status 'empty' with the exact label and no pick — never an invented pick. excludedPick accepts a pick name string or an {id, name} object, as buildRerankArgs does. Spends Qloo quota (guarded).
